=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:422-451 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` is never written to `true`, so the build step's Semble index guard always skips the prefetch path.
  WHY: The install step only writes `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=false` on failure and never flips it on success, so the later `"[ "${SEMBLE_AVAILABLE:-false}" != "true" ]"` check remains true.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:134-422 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `semble_max_chunks` is no longer clamped before being passed to Semble's `--top-k`.
  WHY: Values like `0` or `999` now reach Semble directly, which breaks overflow fallback and existing assertions that depended on the old `[1, 20]` normalization.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-440 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Structured Semble query/fallback telemetry was removed and replaced with a bare fallback `print()`.
  WHY: Success no longer emits `SEMBLE_QUERY ... chunks=... bytes=... ms=...`, fallback logs lose the `ms=` field and escape handling, and the existing telemetry assertions in `tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` fail.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-229 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Cached issue metadata is reused without verifying that it belongs to the current issue number.
  WHY: Dropping the `.number` equality check means any stale non-empty `ISSUE_META_FILE` can supply the wrong labels/body; reviewers ranged from high to critical, and the highest severity claimed is critical.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-381 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose prompt no longer includes the Semble-backed codebase-context block.
  WHY: Removing `build_diagnose_semble_query()` and its injection leaves the diagnose phase with only static issue/diff/error text; reviewers ranged from medium/high to critical, and the highest severity claimed is critical.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:299-317 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The optional Semble bootstrap scripts are staged into `scripts/` but never added to `_fetched_scripts`.
  WHY: `scripts/.gitignore` is generated from `_fetched_scripts`, so these transient helpers remain unignored and can show up as untracked files in consumer repos.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:39-62 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-placeholder checks only match placeholders when they occupy the entire line.
  WHY: Inline `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}` or `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` survives replacement and bypasses the guard, so the rendered prompt can contain raw template markers and still exit 0.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:124-133 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `append_semble_query_section()` is defined but has no call sites.
  WHY: The script only uses `append_semble_query_text_section()`, so the helper is dead code with maintenance cost only.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:1-140 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The new contract test is not referenced by any explicit CI allowlist.
  WHY: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml`, and `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` do not invoke this file, so the Semble prefetch contract is never exercised in CI.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:440-475 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The build step writes `SEMBLE_BIN` to `$GITHUB_ENV` a second time after the install step already exported it.
  WHY: Both steps set the same value, so the later append is redundant and harmless.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:422-443,451 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` is never set to `true` by the workflow YAML itself.
  WHY: The install step only writes `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=false` on failure paths, and the build step checks `[ "${SEMBLE_AVAILABLE:-false}" != "true" ]`, so the Semble index build is always skipped.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:320-335 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `semble_max_chunks` is passed directly to `--top-k` without clamping.
  WHY: The removed normalization no longer caps values at 20 or floors them at 1, so `0` can produce an empty query and large values pass through unchecked.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:418-435 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Structured Semble telemetry is gone from the overflow path.
  WHY: The success path no longer emits `SEMBLE_QUERY ... chunks=... bytes=... ms=...`, and the fallback path now uses a bare `print()` without the prior structured timing fields.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:122-223 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Cached issue metadata is reused without verifying that it belongs to the current issue.
  WHY: The removed `issue_meta_matches_issue()` check no longer validates `.number` against `$ISSUE_NUMBER`, so stale metadata can be reused across runs.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-381 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The diagnose prompt no longer includes the Semble-backed codebase-context block.
  WHY: Removing `build_diagnose_semble_query()` and its injection leaves the diagnose phase with less codebase context for post-Codex failure analysis.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:302-314 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The optional Semble scripts are staged into `scripts/` but never appended to `_fetched_scripts`.
  WHY: The generated `scripts/.gitignore` only covers `_fetched_scripts` members, so these staged files can appear as untracked.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:52-57 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-placeholder guards only catch standalone-line placeholders.
  WHY: The anchored regexes miss inline `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}` or `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`, so those markers can pass through unresolved.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:124-133 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `append_semble_query_section()` is defined but never called.
  WHY: All Semble query assembly uses `append_semble_query_text_section()`, so this helper is dead code.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:1-140 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new contract test is not referenced by any CI workflow allowlist.
  WHY: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml`, and `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` do not include it, so it never runs in CI.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:464-464 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_BIN` is exported a second time in the build step success path.
  WHY: The same value is already written in the install step, so the later `$GITHUB_ENV` append is redundant.
